record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: run `bin/aff` as the entry point, then the orchestra commands, the import boundary, and the skill command scan.

## Approach

Run the acceptance commands. Affidavit commands run in the affidavit phase worktree. Orchestra commands run in `~/orchestra` on `phase/standalone-aff`. Do not add features. A failure goes back to the task that owns that criterion.

1. `python3 -m pytest tests/test_standalone_cli.py -q -k verdict_without_runtime`
2. `python3 -m pytest tests/test_standalone_cli.py -q -k rejects_store_commands`
3. `python3 -m pytest tests/test_evidence_layout.py -q -k no_store_tokens`
4. `cd "$HOME/orchestra" && bin/orchestra check --help && bin/orchestra close-batch --help && python3 -m pytest tests/test_affidavit_check.py tests/test_close_batch.py tests/test_affidavit_aa.py tests/test_aa_resolve.py -q`
5. `cd "$HOME/orchestra" && python3 -m pytest tests/test_affidavit_import_boundary.py -q`
6. `cd "$HOME/orchestra" && python3 -m pytest tests/test_orchestra_commands.py -q`

payload.title: Verify aff stands alone from the workflow store
